name: Morning calendar debrief
description: Daily scan of today's calendar; add a 5-minute [debrief] block at the start of each meeting with short prep context.
title: Scan today's calendar and add 5-min [debrief] blocks at the start of each meeting
notes:
Use the apple-tasks CLI in a shell (bash). Do not invent Calendar.app clicks.

For each meeting today (skip all-day; skip titles already starting with [debrief]):
1. List today: `apple-tasks events list --from YYYY-MM-DD --to YYYY-MM-DD` (use today's date for both).
2. Create a 5-minute block at that meeting's start: `apple-tasks events add --start 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm' --duration 5 --notes '…' '[debrief]<exact meeting name>'`
3. Put short prep context in --notes (topic/attendees from the parent event if available).
4. Do not modify the original meeting.
Idempotent: if a [debrief] sibling already exists for that meeting, skip it.
